errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors are arranged in descending order by size. Visually, going clockwise from the largest slice (40%), the order of percentages is 40%, 35%, 5%, 2%, 16%, 2%. The presence of the 16% slice after the 2% slice breaks the descending order.
The description fails to mention that the pie chart is presented in a 3D style, which is a prominent visual characteristic of the figure.
